calls.text:
Approved by Okey, 2026-11-04.

· Mode is global; memories stay per project.
· Loaded in full 5,000 tokens, list 2,000.
· Limits: title 120, summary 280, note 8,000.
· Unavailable: no memory in this workspace, with the reason; the mode cards stay choosable.
· Off keeps the manager.
· An update note replaces 'loads at the start'.
· No INDEX.md.
· A Save-and-tell-me receipt expands to the saved memory, read-only.
· 'Memory isn't context' well near the top of the tab, in every state (Okey, after approval).
· 'Pin' is 'Always load in full' / 'Loaded in full' in the UI; the file keeps pinned: (Okey).
